topic: المرفق العام الاقتصادي — زاوية جديدة: 3 علامات تحذيرية قبل اتخاذ القرار
prompt:
Create one photorealistic editorial image for an Egyptian legal-awareness post. Depict the exact concrete action, object, document type, evidence, and setting in the visual brief; do not substitute a generic lawyer portrait, courthouse, scales, gavel, handshake, or stock office. Set the scene unmistakably in present-day Egypt in the 2020s: modern Cairo/Giza streets, contemporary apartments, ordinary current offices, current-model smartphones, laptops, cars, furniture, clothing, and materials. ABSOLUTE STYLE BAN: this is NOT ancient Egypt, NOT Pharaonic, NOT archaeological, NOT historical, NOT a period drama, and NOT a fantasy scene. Never show pyramids, sphinxes, obelisks, hieroglyphics, ancient temples, tombs, sarcophagi, mummies, pharaohs, royal crowns, ancient columns, papyrus, sandstone monuments, gold masks, ancient Egyptian motifs, or ornamental Pharaonic patterns. Do not use Egyptian heritage or ancient civilization as visual shorthand for modern Egypt. The legal issue must be shown in a normal contemporary urban environment. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, seals, signatures, watermarks, or invented legal documents. Keep the main subject clear and visually dominant, with natural lighting and realistic proportions. The scene must communicate the specific issue without adding facts not present in the source.
LEGAL TOPIC: المرفق العام الاقتصادي — زاوية جديدة: 3 علامات تحذيرية قبل اتخاذ القرار
SOURCE CONTEXT: تخيل أنك تدير منشأة اقتصادية تقدم خدمة حيوية للجمهور، وفجأة وجدت نفسك أمام ضغوط لرفع الأسعار أو تغيير معايير الخدمة بشكل يمس جوهر التزامك، هنا تظهر طبيعة المرفق العام الاقتصادي ككيان محكوم بقواعد تختلف عن الشركات التجارية العادية، فالمشرع يضع قيوداً تهدف لضمان استمرارية الخدمة وانتظامها، وقبل أن تتخذ قراراً قد يضعك في مواجهة قانونية، راقب هذه العلامات الثلاث، أولاً: هل القرار يمس جوهر التزامك التعاقدي تجاه الجمهور؟ إذا كان الأمر كذلك، فالتغيير الانفرادي قد يفتح باباً للمسؤولية التعاقدية، ثانياً: هل هناك نصوص قانونية أو تنظيمية تفرض عليك أسعاراً أو مواصفات محددة؟ في هذه الحالة، أي خروج عنها دون
visual_description: A modern utility office bathed in soft natural light from a large window. At a clean, white desk sits a mid‑30s manager (gender ambiguous, business‑casual attire) leaning slightly forward, hand poised over a pen, eyes focused on three documents laid out in front of them. 1. To the left, an open contract booklet with thick pages; a bright yellow strip highlights a central paragraph, visually emphasizing the “core commitment” clause. 2. In the center, a single sheet of official‑looking paper rests on a matte black clipboard; a raised circular seal with a textured rim protrudes from the page, indicating a government regulation that fixes prices and specifications. 3. To the right, a sleek tablet displays a simple white‑on‑blue flowchart: a continuous line looping through icons that suggest uninterrupted service (a pipe, a power symbol, a clock), representing the facility’s need to maintain service continuity. Behind the desk, a wall‑mounted digital screen shows live service metrics—smooth line graphs and gauge needles—without any visible numbers or text, reinforcing the operational context. The composition is shot from a slightly elevated eye‑level angle, capturing the manager’s thoughtful posture, the three focal documents, and the background screen in a single, cohesive frame. Ambient office lighting blends with the daylight, creating a calm yet attentive atmosphere. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A modern, professional office desk scene with no people or hands. The focus is on three distinct items on the desk: 1. A contract with a bright yellow highlighted clause. 2. A matte black clipboard holding an official document with a physical embossed circular seal. 3. A sleek tablet displaying a digital flowchart of a utility service cycle with icons for power and pipes. In the background, a digital screen displays clean operational service metrics (graphs) without numbers. High quality, professional lighting, 4:5 aspect ratio. No scales of justice, no gavels, no statues. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
